confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rounded central estimates from several Pai and northern Thailand price guides of mixed date and reliability, cross-checked against Chiang Mai sources. No Pai wine-by-the-glass price was found; wine is set from the local beer relationship and checked against higher nearby menu examples. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July low season, not based on searches or live listings. FX is the 18 Nov 2026 RBA observation as reported in search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pai-specific guide and bar price reports for food and drink, cross-checked against Chiang Mai cost-of-living and menu sources, which were broadly similar in level. Wine uses the local beer relationship, checked against northern Thai and Bangkok wine-by-the-glass examples. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small northern Thai tourist town in July low season.
